note: Lions asked for much simpler graphics, or none. Use one only if the cut needs it, never two at once.

mg.title: Kampala pin
mg.src: Location pin text written in the blueprint row 00:05–00:09.
mg.use: The location pin the plan asks for, 00:05 to 00:07, after the top text is out.

mg.title: Found a family

text.main: I found a family of Lions

mg.use: Only after the pin goes out at 00:07, as he says it.

mg.title: We became together
mg.src: Uganda Lion, IMG_7819.MOV [01:13] “and we became together”
mg.use: Small tag as he says it. Gone before MG 4.

mg.title: My best friends

text.main: one of them is my best friends

mg.src: Uganda Lion, IMG_7819.MOV [01:13]–[01:19]. Check “friend/friends” by ear.
mg.use: Short full-frame cutaway on “best friends”. Cut out before the name.

mg.title: Club president

text.main: going to be my club president

mg.use: Over him on the 105% punch-in as he says it. Keep his laugh clear.

mg.title: People in need

text.main: In the entire world, we have so many people in need of our hands, of our help.

mg.use: Only if you add this line to the cut, after “club president” and before the tie-back.

mg.title: Find him in the hall
mg.use: Frames him at the cut to the wider hall IMG_7822. Move it to where he stands.

mg.title: Talk to any Lion

text.main: talk to any Lion, they are willing to receive you

mg.src: Uganda Lion, IMG_7822.MOV [00:23]–[00:28]. The transcript tool wrote “land”; the blueprint says “Lion”.
mg.use: Full-frame cutaway as he says it, then back to him.

mg.title: Friends all over the world

text.main: you will create new friends from all over the world

mg.use: Over him as he says it. Gone by the 0.5 s hold after “world”.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Only the official Lions lockup from the Lions brand files. Nothing else on it.
mg.src: Lions' latest end card video (Lions CTA.mp4, sent as the latest Lions end card on Slack, 20 Aug 2026): the Lions emblem on the brand gradient with Find your local club at lionsclubs.org.
mg.use: This is the end card, the client's own file. Put it at 00:27 after the last line and use it exactly as it is. The script adds: if Atdhe picks no graphics, cut to black after the last line instead.
